name: com.terraingrasssystem.grass
description: GPU-procedural grass for Unity Terrain (URP RenderGraph). Compute-generated Bezier blades, CPU tile culling, GPU per-blade culling and depth occlusion, two stochastic LODs, wind, interaction sources, and a painted density mask. Includes editor painting and noise/mask tools.

samples.description: Example scene and assets for Terrain Grass System.
